title: VUA application-contract task snapshot v0.1
description: Authoritative task snapshot shape for the application-contract v0.1 task face (task.get / task.list values and the task object embedded in task.startDemo responses). This machine-readable face freezes the snapshot increment registered by the BOARD #22 result-reflux ruling (core proposal 020, 2026-09-12): an OPTIONAL result field carries the task's Done payload on the snapshot channel with the same value the task.completed event publishes — both project the single stored task result, so the snapshot and event channels can never disagree. Invariants frozen here: (1) result appears only on succeeded / succeeded_with_warnings snapshots — failed and cancelled snapshots never carry a result (the failure fact travels the error field), and non-terminal snapshots never carry one; (2) result is an object — a null result is an honest absence and is projected as field-absent, never as null; (3) the snapshot face makes no structural promise about the payload's internal shape — the shape is owned by the word list of the operation that produced the task (project-ops payloads self-describe via schemaVersion/operation; production-family payloads follow the production-use-case word list), so this face and the operation word lists evolve independently. The field is additive and backward compatible: every snapshot valid before the increment remains valid.

error.description: Structured failure fact (AppErrorV01); present only where the runtime recorded one.

result.description: The task's Done payload, verbatim; shape owned by the producing operation's word list. Only succeeded / succeeded_with_warnings snapshots may carry it.

allOf.$comment: Frozen invariant: a result reflux requires an honestly completed task. failed/cancelled snapshots carry the failure face (error), never a result; non-terminal snapshots carry neither.
Frozen invariant: failed tasks surface the failure fact through the error field.
